close_reason: Added doc comment to handle_changes in jmap-server/handlers.rs explaining: when to set updatedProperties non-null (count-only updates), the client optimization it enables, and why empty array is wrong.
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_changes line 93: updatedProperties is hardcoded to Value::Null. The doc comment says 'always null for MemoryBackend (no partial-property-update tracking)'. But the RFC says updatedProperties enables clients to skip fetching non-count properties if only counts changed — it's an optimization signal. A contributor implementing a production backend will not know they should populate this field. The comment should explain what a real backend should set updatedProperties to (the list of changed count fields when only those changed), and how this enables the optimization described in RFC 8621 §2.2.
title: Mailbox/changes updatedProperties always null — doc comment misses spec intent
